readingMode: Every physical page, panel, illustration, timeline/statistical/footer and folding instruction read directly in original-page PNG renders. Native extraction is empty/incomplete; excerpts are visual readings with no machine-checked transcription.
territorialScope: Offered by the archived July21 2023 general-election campaign page under downloads8010/8014 for Alicante Congress candidacy. The decalogue original path isMay2022; adoption is explicit, not an inferred election replacement.

coverage.authoredAnalysis: Read all four panels: self-employed numerical/statistical claims and pie chart (74/13/9/4); complete party timeline March2020-April2023; contact/party identity and Alicante office; all ten decalogue headings. Figures are source claims, not validated statistics. No separate 23J label; adoption verified on campaign page.

Read every proposal in both columns: first-degree care discount/mutual benefit, family hiring, low-income rate and unpaid invoice VAT; judges-only selection, lifetime pay abolition, two rounds and 50% fulfilment/confidence, annual budget audits; targeted hiring aid; riders, drivers/rest, diesel aid, coastal fishing, hair/beauty/sport 10%VAT, hospitality differentiation; Austrian account, retirement after40contributionyears and proportionate extra-year pension; animal protection/nonprofit treatments; double-payer tax, career computation, farm-gate price regulation and retail minimum-price limits, local SME commerce; security pay/drunk/drug driver penalties; prescribed aids and stable primary care employment; social services/care-home staffing/public-building design/migration rights/special education costs; national education law; occupation procedures, repatriation on convictions OR repeated arrests, innocence/false testimony, juvenile sanctions. Retain each condition and conflicts with main document.

Read all five folding steps: print both sheets double-sided A4; fold green lines backwards, fold remaining marked line, complete brochure. Miniature older-panel pictures illustrate folding and do not provide an independently legible policy annex; no new full-size proposal.
